description: This file contains internal test classes for storage-related functionality in the Orleans framework, specifically focusing on relational storage backend testing including various read/write consistency scenarios and parallel operations.

classes.name: CommonStorageTests
classes.description: A test class for common storage behaviors in Orleans relational storage backend, implementing various scenario-based tests such as write/read, concurrent modifications, and clearing state.

methods.name: GetTestReferenceAndState
methods.description: Creates a grain ID and corresponding grain state with either numeric or string grain ID.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_Relational_WriteReadIdCyrillic
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a grain state with Cyrillic characters in the grain ID to check Unicode handling.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Verifies that writing a duplicate state with null ETag throws an InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteInconsistentFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to write a state with an unexpected version (ETag) results in an InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteReadWriteReadStatesInParallel
methods.description: Performs concurrent writes and reads to simulate parallel activity, validating version updates across multiple grains.

methods.name: Store_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests writing, clearing, and reading grain state to ensure consistency and proper versioning.

methods.name: Store_WriteRead
methods.description: Performs write followed by read to verify correctness of stored grain state.
